info.title: MED1.UZ Enterprise API
info.description:
Unified REST API for MED1.UZ — Auth, User, Directory (Clinics/Doctors/Diagnostics/Pharmacies/Maternity), Appointments, EMR, Payments, Notifications, Maps, and 14 AI services.

**Authentication:** `x-api-key` header (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).

**HMAC (optional):** if the partner or key has `require_hmac = true`, requests must include:
- `x-timestamp`: unix seconds (max ±300s skew)
- `x-signature`: hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, `${ts}.${METHOD}.${path}.${sha256Hex(body)}`))

**Sandbox:** keys with `is_sandbox = true` are routed to a mock layer that returns deterministic fake data (never touches production). Every response includes `sandbox: true`.

**Rate limits:** 30 req/min, 1000 req/day (per key by default).

**Disclaimer:** AI responses are informational only.

sandbox.description: Present when the response was served by the sandbox mock layer.
